author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: स किं त्वत्तोऽन्य इत्यतोऽहमेवेति सप्रमाणकमाह ॥ यस्मादिति । यस्मात्क्षरं चातीतः अक्षरादुत्तमोऽतः कारणात् । लोके पौरुषेयग्रन्थे वेदे अपौरुषेयग्रन्थे च प्रथितः प्रसिद्धः पुरुषोत्तमोऽहमेवेत्यर्थः ॥ १५.१८॥
translation:
For the reason that I am above the Kshara and far above the Akshara also, for this reason I am well known as Purushottama, bull in the Vedas and in the holy works of the world (18.) 
V. Loka: the works written by holy men in the world. Veda is the eternal testimony.
A. In order to impress that what has been said is His real meaning the benefit of this knowledge is declared as follows:
